description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the TimeUntilDisconnectNotification class, especially its construction from messages with different TTD (Time To Disconnect) property values. It uses JUnit for testing and ProtonHelper for message creation.

classes.name: TimeUntilDisconnectNotificationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the TimeUntilDisconnectNotification class's message parsing logic.

methods.name: testNotificationIsConstructedIfTtdIsSetToPositiveValue
methods.description: Tests that a TimeUntilDisconnectNotification is correctly constructed when a positive TTD value is set.

methods.name: testNotificationIsConstructedIfTtdIsSetToUnlimited
methods.description: Tests that a TimeUntilDisconnectNotification is correctly constructed when the TTD value indicates unlimited duration.

methods.name: assertNotificationProperties
methods.description: Helper method to verify properties of the notification object.

methods.name: createTestMessage
methods.description: Helper method to create a test message with preset properties for testing.
